# AND Gate Implementation Using Two Push Buttons

# DESCRIPTION:

         *To implement an AND gate using two push buttons, a 9V battery, resistor, LED, and soldering connections.*

# COMPONENTS REQUIRED:

* 2 Push Buttons  
* 9V Battery  
* LED  
* Resistor  
* Connecting Wires  
* Soldering Iron and Solder Wire  
    
  ![][image1]

# WORKING PRINCIPLE:

* The two push buttons are used as the two inputs (A and B) of the AND gate. The LED acts as the output.  
* The LED glows only when both push buttons are pressed. If either one or both buttons are not pressed, the LED remains OFF.


# TRUTH TABLE:

*![][image2]*

# PROCEDURE:

* Connect the 9V battery to the circuit.  
* Connect the two push buttons in series.  
* Connect the resistor and LED in the circuit.  
* Solder all the components and wires properly.  
* Press the push buttons in different combinations.  
* Observe the LED output and verify it with the truth table.

# RESULT:

The AND gate was successfully implemented using two push buttons. The LED glows only when both push.Buttons are pressed simultaneously.
